Name: User ID
Description: The application generated ID to uniquely identify the user update request. Only available to reference existing records.

Name: Person Number
Description: The person number of the person for whom you are creating or updating the user account.

Name: Add or Remove Role
Description: Specifies whether to add or remove the role identified on the Role Common Name attribute. Set to ADD or REMOVE.

Name: Credentials Email Sent
Description: Indicates whether the user's account and password details email has been sent. Valid values are Y and N. To reset passwords, set this value to N before running the Send User Name and Password E-Mail Notifications process.

Name: Generate User Account
Description: Specifies whether to request a user account for the specified Person Number if no user account exists. Valid values are Y and N.

Name: Person ID
Description: A unique reference to the person for whom you are creating or updating the user account.

Name: Role Common Name
Description: The role code of the role that you want to add to or remove from the user account. For example, specify PER_EMPLOYEE_ABSTRACT rather than Employee.

Name: Role ID
Description: The surrogate ID of the role to add or remove from the user account.

Name: Suspended
Description: Indicates whether to request suspension of the user account or removal of an existing suspension. Valid values are Y and N.

Name: User Category
Description: The category associated with the user. This is not validated when creating the LDAP request. If the value is invalid when processing the LDAP request, the category will be set to the default value.

Name: Username
Description: To request a change to the existing user name, specify a new user name. The existing user name is retained if you do not supply this attribute value. If you set the Generate User Account attribute to Y and leave this attribute blank, then the user name is generated in the enterprise default format.

Name: Source System ID
Description: A value to uniquely identify this record. This must be unique for the source system owner and business object component.

Name: Source System Owner
Description: The name of the source system used to generate the source system ID.

Name: Globally Unique ID
Description: The globally unique ID. Only available to reference existing records, it cannot be supplied for new records.

Name: Reference Context
Description: The context for the user-defined references provided for this component. Don't supply values for this attribute, instead specify the context against this attribute in the METADATA line using the format: SourceRefTableName= context. For example: SourceRefTableName=Store Information.

Name: Reference 1
Description: A user-defined reference value used for reporting and reconciling your data in the staging tables. This information is not saved in the application. You name your reference on the METADATA line using the format Attribute name = Reference name. For example, SourceRef001=Assignment Number.
